nodes.name: MySQL (Update cold_reach_leads - Instantly Add Lead Fail)

parameters.query:
select 
      lc.main_category,
	 lc.category,
	 lc.category_group,
	 lc.category_tr,
	 lc.category_group_tr,
     bl.*
from lead_db.business_leads bl join lead_db.lead_category lc  on bl.category =lc.category
where (bl.email IS NOT NULL 
or bl.email1 IS NOT NULL)
AND  bl.email1 !='[email if found]'
and bl.email1  like "%@%"
and bl.company_name1 is not null
 AND (
  lc.category ="Steuerberater" or
  lc.category ="Finanzberater" or
  lc.category ="Steuerberatung" or
  lc.category ="Anlageberatung" or
  lc.category ="Schuldenberatung" or
  lc.category ="Hypothekenmakler"
  )
 -- AND (
 --  lc.main_category = 'Doktor'  or
 --  lc.main_category = 'İmmo' or
 --    lc.main_category = 'Avukat' or
 --   lc.main_category = 'Handwerk' or 
 --  lc.category = "Autohandler"
 --  )
  and 
(  
 -- bl.pipelined = 1 or
  bl.pipelined IS NULL 
  OR bl.pipelined =2
  or bl.pipelined =3
 ) 
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
limit 100

SELECT 
    cn.*, 
    bl.*, 
    lc.main_category
FROM 
    companies_new cn
JOIN 
    business_leads bl ON cn.cid = bl.cid
JOIN 
    lead_category lc ON bl.category = lc.category
WHERE 
    lc.main_category = 'Doktor'  or
  lc.main_category = 'İmmo' or
  lc.main_category = 'Avukat'
 or lc.main_category = 'Handwerk'
